Best banh mi we had
Aug 2019 • Couples
We stayed at MK Premier for 4 nights and between check out and traveling to the airport we decided to grab lunch at MK to avoid the midday heat. 
After a couple disappointing banh mi experiences in Hanoi we really enjoyed the chicken sandwiches here. 
To our delight, for 40k we received a banh mi, iced green tea and watermelon. The iced coffees were also great. 
Banh mi was on the smaller side but sufficient for lunch. 
Bonus marks for thoughtful presentation and a relaxed environment with ceiling fans.

Great place for a quick sandwich
Oct 2018 • Friends
The front covered ‘atrium ‘ of this old quarter hotel has a few comfortable rattan couches along with tiny low chairs, and much appreciated ceiling fans. The banh mi sandwiches they make are fantastic! A great light lunch if it is just too hot for another bowl of Pho. They do have Diet Coke if you are jonesing for your fix, as well as some lovely iced teas.
